UI_ALA_Options_Info: A-Life: Airwaves & Contracts. Personal display and control settings. Server-wide rules and frequencies are on the host's Sandbox page "A-Life: Airwaves & Contracts".
UI_ALA_Opt_OpenKey_tt: Hotkey to open or close the Airwaves & Contracts window in-game (default: F9).
UI_ALA_Opt_HaloNotices_tt: Show intercepted radio broadcasts and SOS alerts over your character's head when a radio is active.
UI_ALA_Opt_ContextMenu_tt: Show the [A-LIFE] Airwaves & Contracts option when right-clicking radios, vehicles, or SOS sites.
UI_ALA_Opt_WorldMap_tt: Draw active SOS beacons, supply drop zones, and marked signals on the world map and minimap.
UI_ALA_Opt_FreqFilter_tt: Filter which channels appear in the Airwaves Log and overhead notifications.
